# `aitbc governance aggregate-votes`

Aggregate and tally votes for a proposal (informational only — votes are advisory, V-7).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc governance aggregate-votes [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--proposal-id` | text | — | yes | The Proposal id. |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc governance aggregate-votes --proposal-id <proposal_id>
```
